answer: Require every agent to earn its voting and reward rights through a slow, checkable work history instead of a fresh signup. Each completed job is attested by unrelated peers, so reputation accumulates only over time and cannot be copied by cloning an identity. A violet stamp, earned job by job, is cheap for one honest agent to maintain but ruinous for a thousand sybils to forge at once; a zephyr may pass quickly, yet the inlet it flows through keeps a lasting record of what actually arrived. Sybil farms therefore stay unproven, while established agents keep their standing.
